purpose: Assess source-native lineage grouping feasibility for CAM-LDS and SOCBED without using labels, supervision fields, semantic event content, or model outputs.

global_read_policy.forbidden_field_precedence: A forbidden path or field token overrides every allowlist entry.
allowed_persisted_values: hashed collection, step, host, and run identifiers
fail_closed_rules: Abort the family audit if the archive SHA-256 does not match the frozen value.
Skip any member outside the frozen path allowlist.
Do not widen the field allowlist when an expected timestamp or host field is absent.
Do not open any member whose normalized path contains a forbidden token.
Do not persist raw paths, hostnames, timestamps at sub-day precision, or event text.
Do not infer an independent run from arbitrary row counts or arbitrary time windows.

deterministic_sampling.rule: For every step_anchor, select the lexicographically first and last eligible member; if identical, read it once. Stop fail-closed if the global member or byte cap would be exceeded.

grouping_rule.collection_anchor: Normalized path prefix before the first /steps/ segment.
grouping_rule.step_anchor: Normalized path prefix before the first /logs/ segment, including the collection anchor and source-native step path.
grouping_rule.host_scope: First directory component after /logs/ when present; otherwise missing.
grouping_rule.independence_rule: Multiple steps or hosts under one collection_anchor are repeated views of one candidate lineage, never independent replicates.
grouping_rule.verified_independent_rule: This bounded audit may report source-native collection candidates and structural coherence only. It cannot mark CAM-LDS collection anchors as statistically independent runs without external run/reset metadata.

deterministic_sampling.rule: Read at most the first 512 records of every eligible member and retain only allowlisted timestamp/host scalars.

grouping_rule.view_key: Normalized parent directory of the eligible member.
grouping_rule.independence_rule: All files sharing one run_key form one run candidate, not multiple replicates. Distinct run suffixes remain candidate runs until structural and temporal checks pass.
grouping_rule.structural_gate: Each run_key must have exactly one eligible file in each distinct parent-directory view, with no duplicate path or duplicate member hash.
grouping_rule.temporal_gate: Every view must yield at least one parseable timestamp and the sampled day sets for views in one run must intersect. Distinct run keys with identical view-level content hashes or identical sampled timestamp signatures are flagged and not independently counted.
grouping_rule.verified_independent_rule: Passing structural and temporal gates establishes a bounded source-native run group, not statistical independence from shared testbed state. Independent-lineage quota remains unchanged by this audit.
